description: Multiplayer voxel engine: an authoritative Rust server (voxelize crate) with TypeScript client packages (@voxelize/core and friends) built on three.js.
rules: The server is authoritative: gameplay state changes on the server and streams to clients.
Entities that can number in the dozens are instanced with defineSkinnedFamily from @voxelize/core, never a THREE.Mesh per entity.
Bake per-variant work during load with InstancedEntityRoster.warm, not the first time something appears.
Read packages/core/skills/<topic>/SKILL.md for the task before writing engine code; examples/ holds the worked, compiling version.
